about: Tartarus bosses for data/bosses.json, written by hand from the Our Trickster Online wiki (oto.fandom.com, CC-BY-SA): Koiosu, True Kronos, Tartarus Quests. The ggFTW wiki has no pages for them. Monster ids are the client's (Koiosu = 'Nose Ios', True Kronos = 'Jean Kronos' in MonsterParamEx2).

getThere.t: Level 260+. Pay Homeless Ian at Megalopolis Square 5,000 Galders to go to New Content Development Office 1 (later he takes you to Office 2).
Developer Project Manager L - Preparation of New Content Development: bring Content Design Report, Content Art Report and Development Process Report.
Developer J - Stolen Content Blueprint and Developer K - Lost Work: dig Content Sketch 1, 2 and 3 in New Content Development Office - Basement 1 and 2.
Developer J - Construction of the System, then Developer H - Constructed System: 10 Tail of Uparupa, 10 Fin of Uparupa, 10 Drop Test Dummy (Cave Uparupa).
Developer Project Manager L - Don Giuvanni's Disappearance: talk to him again at New Content Development Office 2.

To reach Office 2: Rock Fragment in Basement 2 -> Abandoned Control Room. Beat Scylla (Control Room, Lv.480, alone) for a Suspicious ID Card, give it to Old Control Device (you keep needing the card for Control Room Door).
At Office 2: Don Giuvanni - Strange Device, then talk to Strange Device (next to him) to go to Tartarus Entrance.

bosses.name: Koiosu
bosses.location: Tartarus - Cage of Steel God Koiosu

walk.t: Tartarus Entrance
Have a Book of God: buy one from Monkey T at New Content Development Office 2 (20,000 Galders), or bring Kyu an Oil Can of God (Kyu - Falsified Book of God).
Warden Oceanus - Tartarus Access Management, then talk to Door of Tartarus and pick 1. Koiosu Prison (B1, B2, Lv.260+). Don't cancel: the book is used up.
Steel God B1: left platform -> Cage 6 -> 16 -> 24 -> right platform
Access Control Device A sends you into B1. Walk to Cage 6 and take its portal to Cage 16.
In Cage 16 talk to the Gap in the wall (near the portal to Cage 23): it takes you to Cage 24.
In Cage 24 talk to the Gap: it takes you to the right platform. Access Control Device B sends you to B2.
Steel God B2: left platform -> Cage 1 -> 11 -> 21 -> Secret Cage 1 -> right platform
Access Control Device A sends you into B2. Walk to Cage 1, take the portal to Cage 11, then the portal to Cage 21.
In Cage 21 talk to the Gap in the wall: it takes you to Secret Cage 1.
In Secret Cage 1 talk to the Gap: it takes you to the right platform.
Koiosu's cage
Access Control Device B sends you to Tartarus - Cage of Steel God Koiosu.
Warden Oceanus - Tartarus Hunting 1 asks for Koiosu in 20 minutes.

notes.t: Resists magic. M Dark Barrier sends back both physical and magic damage.

bosses.name: True Kronos
bosses.restrict: Level 320+, Warden Oceanus - 9. Barrier Registration done

walk.t: Tartarus Entrance

Book of God (Monkey T at Office 2, 20,000 Galders, or Kyu - Falsified Book of God). Warden Oceanus - Tartarus Access Management, then Door of Tartarus: pick 2. True Kronos Prison (B3, B4, Lv.320+). You land in Ancient God B3 Cage 1.
King Poppuri is in B3 Cage 1; report his tests to him in B4. Certification Registry, Warden Oceanus and Poppuri 1 to 10 are in B4. Each King Poppuri test also gives 1–3 of a Key 8 material.
Part 1: Key 1 -> 1. Barrier
King Poppuri - 1. Test: kill 1 True Ancient Fire Hand in 20 min (B3 Cage 4, 6, 9, 11, 14, 16) -> Key 1.
Certification Registry - 1. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 1 - 1. Barrier Test (Key 1): kill Ancient Dragon in 20 min (B4 Cage 1) -> 1. Barrier Certificate.
Part 2: Key 3 -> 3. Barrier
King Poppuri - 3. Test: 3 Chain of Pirate (Ancient Pirate), 3 Exhaust Stack of Bio Junk (Ancient Bio Junk), 3 Fetters of Guard Ian (Ancient Guard Ian) -> Key 3.
Certification Registry - 3. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 3 - 3. Barrier Test (Key 3): kill Ancient Sisyphus in 20 min (B4 Cage 3).
Part 3: Key 4 -> 4. Barrier

King Poppuri - 4. Test: find Robin Van Peruoza through the Gap in the wall of B3 Cage 6–19 (Secret Space 6–19). Robin's test: 10 Ancient Bijou Golem in 10 min -> Scroll of Robin -> Key 4. No other monster quest in your log.
Certification Registry - 4. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 4 - 4. Barrier Test (Key 4): kill Ancient Ixion in 15 min (B4 Cage 4).
Part 4: Key 6 -> 6. Barrier
King Poppuri - 6. Test: Proof of King Poppuri from Poseidon's Surprise Spot. Combine Map of King Poppuri part 1 and 2 at OK-19 or Certification Registry and follow the map -> Key 6.
Certification Registry - 6. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 6 - 6. Barrier Test (Key 6): kill Ancient Hecate in 15 min (B4 Cage 6).
Part 5: Key 8 -> 8. Barrier
Combine Key 8 material 1–4 (from the King Poppuri tests) at OK-19 or Certification Registry -> Key 8.
Warden Oceanus - 8. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 8 - 8. Barrier Test (Key 8): kill Ancient Tantalus in 10 min (B4 Cage 8) -> Key 9.
Part 6: Key 9 -> 9. Barrier
Warden Oceanus - 9. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 9 - 9. Barrier Test (Key 9): kill Chronos (Lv.950) in 10 min (B4 Cage 9) -> Key 10.
Part 7: Key 10 -> True Kronos
Warden Oceanus - 10. Barrier Registration. Poppuri 10 - 10. Barrier Test (Key 10): kill True Kronos in 10 min (B4 Cage 10).
Next time you only need Parts 5–7: Key 8 -> Key 9 -> Key 10. The King Poppuri tests can be taken all at once.

notes.t: Players report that he can vanish when several people hunt him at once, and Key 10 is lost.

puzzles.title: B3 Secret Space: where Robin Van Peruoza is
text: Go through the Gap in the wall of a B3 cage (6 to 19) into its Secret Space.
